main_objectives: Allow customers to book tables and view menus online
Let managers track reservations and kitchen inventory
Reward repeat guests with a loyalty points system

user_roles_and_permissions.description: Full access — manages staff, menu, and settings
Can view and update reservations; cannot delete data
Can book tables, view menu, and track loyalty points

entities.name: Reservation
entities.description: A table booking made by a customer

entities.name: MenuItem
entities.description: A dish or drink on the seasonal menu

entities.name: LoyaltyAccount
entities.description: Tracks points earned and redeemed by each customer

relationships.description: Each reservation is linked to one loyalty account
A reservation can pre-select multiple menu items

ui_pages.name: Home
ui_pages.purpose: Hero section with restaurant story, featured dishes, and book-a-table CTA

ui_pages.name: Menu
ui_pages.purpose: Seasonal menu with category filters and dish details

ui_pages.name: Reservations
ui_pages.purpose: Online booking form — date, time, party size, special requests

ui_pages.name: Loyalty Program
ui_pages.purpose: Explain how to earn and redeem points; show tier benefits

ui_pages.name: About Us
ui_pages.purpose: Our story, head chefs, and culinary philosophy

functional_requirements.title: Online Table Reservations
functional_requirements.description: Customers can book a table by choosing date, time, and party size. Confirmation email is sent automatically.

functional_requirements.title: Reservation Management Dashboard
functional_requirements.description: Staff can view all reservations by date, confirm or cancel bookings, and add notes.

functional_requirements.title: Menu Management
functional_requirements.description: Admin can add, edit, and mark menu items as seasonal or unavailable. Supports bulk upload.

functional_requirements.title: Loyalty Points Tracking
functional_requirements.description: System awards points per reservation. Admin can view, adjust, and redeem customer balances.

functional_requirements.title: Customer Loyalty Portal
functional_requirements.description: Customers can log in to check their points balance and tier status.
